pages.text: Living creatures respond strongly to mana. Common fish appear resilient enough to survive transformation in it.$(br2)The resulting species can be collected in buckets, emit light, and possess behaviors or renewable brushed materials absent from their mundane forms.

The transformations are discovered through exposing the corresponding ordinary fish to mana. Each transformed fish has its own ten-minute brushing cooldown.$(br2)The three forms I can now investigate are Glow Trout, Bright Salmon, and Amefysh.
pages.title: A Cautious Experiment
